description: Defines the WebError class which implements the api.WebError interface, encapsulating an error and optionally associating it with a Page object.

classes.name: WebError
classes.description: A class representing a web error with an associated page and error object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a WebError instance with an optional Page and an Error object.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the associated Page object or null.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the Error object contained in the WebError.
